02 What's standard on every job

The work below isn't an upgrade — it's the baseline for anything we sign our name on.

  • 001Mix design reviewWe read the structural spec and coordinate with your batch plant before day-of-pour.
  • 002Cylinder breaksFour cylinders per 50 cy, tested at 7 and 28 days by a certified lab. Results emailed.
  • 003Inspection coordinationWe schedule with the jurisdiction and meet the inspector on-site — not your problem.
  • 004Clean demobForm ties pulled, patch work done, site swept. You get back a pour-ready site for the next trade.
